info.title: lumeo
info.description: Vendorize Lumeo components directly into your project.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Lumeo CLI — vendorize Lumeo components into your project.

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: -h
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create a lumeo.json in the current directory.

options.name: --namespace
options.description: Target namespace for generated components (e.g. MyApp.Components).

options.name: --path
options.description: Components folder relative to the current directory. Default: Components/Ui

options.name: --registry
options.description: Registry URL. Default: https://lumeo.nativ.sh/registry/registry.json

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing lumeo.json.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Accept all defaults, skip prompts (CI mode).

options.name: --with-css
options.description: Copy Lumeo's pre-built CSS/JS into wwwroot/ (no Tailwind required).

options.name: --with-tailwind
options.description: Scaffold Tailwind v4 setup (Styles/input.css + package.json).

options.name: --no-assets
options.description: Skip asset setup entirely (you'll wire CSS up yourself).

options.name: --local
options.description: Copy assets from a local Lumeo checkout (dev only).

commands.name: add
commands.description: Vendor a component (and its deps) into your project.

options.name: --local
options.description: Read registry + files from local filesystem (for development).

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip dependency prompts — auto-install.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite all conflicts without prompting (CI).

options.name: --skip-existing
options.description: Silently skip files that already exist.

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Alias of --force (legacy).

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would happen without writing files.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Pull upstream changes for a component (or all installed).

options.name: --local
options.description: Read registry + files from local filesystem.

options.name: --force
options.description: Update without prompts.

options.name: --check
options.description: Report drift without writing. Exit 1 if drift found, 0 if clean.

options.name: --force-reset
options.description: Restore to registry version, discarding local edits.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would happen without writing files.

arguments.name: COMPONENT
arguments.description: Component to update. Omit to update all installed components.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Delete a vendored component from your project.

options.name: --force
options.description: Skip confirmation prompt.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would happen without deleting files.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all available components grouped by category.

options.name: --local
options.description: Read registry from local filesystem.

options.name: --category
options.description: Filter to a single category (e.g. Forms).

options.name: --json
options.description: Dump registry entries as JSON for tooling consumption.

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Show files that have drifted from the registry version.

options.name: --local
options.description: Read registry + files from local filesystem.

commands.name: update-assets
commands.description: Refresh copied CSS/JS assets (when assets.mode == prebuilt).

options.name: --local
options.description: Read assets from a local Lumeo checkout.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite all files without prompting.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would happen without writing files.
